Best on soil and water: living-cover days a year: 165 days; median rain on bare soil a year: 82.3 mm; crop families: 2 families.
Fewest weather stress events (dry pre-planting windows and years with heavy rain on bare soil): 1.8 on average vs 2.0 for What I do now.
Ranks best on what you weighted most (median 10-year margin, living-cover days a year, median rain on bare soil a year), using rank positions only (no score).
